deployment_notes: deploy each service separately, then wire RAG, tools, n8n workflows, MCP gateways, and Skills on top of the shared infrastructure layer

ingestion.boundary_notes: keep ingestion local, write only to repository-backed storage and the private vector store, and avoid external publication during indexing
ingestion.retry_notes: retry parse and embedding steps for transient failures; fail fast on invalid source documents

steps.name: discover
steps.purpose: find eligible local source files and documents

steps.name: parse
steps.purpose: extract text and structure from source files

steps.name: chunk
steps.purpose: split content into manageable retrieval chunks

steps.name: embed
steps.purpose: send chunks to the embedding service

steps.name: index
steps.purpose: persist vectors and metadata to the vector database

steps.name: verify
steps.purpose: check the indexed documents and record ingestion status

model_layer.deployment_notes: deploy model services alongside the shared infrastructure layer with explicit persistent storage and local-only access by default
model_layer.routing_notes: route generation to the local LLM service and embedding jobs to the embedding service before crossing any external boundary

services.inference_notes: serve locally to keep prompts and outputs private
services.name: local LLM service
services.storage: model weights stored on local persistent disk

services.inference_notes: batch or stream embeddings for ingestion and incremental updates
services.name: embedding service
services.storage: embedding model weights stored on local persistent disk

rag_api.boundary_notes: keep retrieval and generation on the internal network; expose only the RAG API surface if external access is explicitly approved

steps.name: retrieve
steps.purpose: fetch relevant context from the vector database

steps.name: rerank
steps.purpose: rank retrieved chunks for answer quality

steps.name: generate
steps.purpose: ask the local LLM service to produce a grounded answer

steps.name: cite
steps.purpose: attach source citations to the final response

service_layer.boundary_notes: deploy AI services behind the shared infrastructure layer, keep model and vector storage private, and expose only the RAG API if needed

services.name: local LLM service
services.persistence: model weights on local persistent storage

services.name: embedding service
services.persistence: embedding model weights on local persistent storage

services.name: vector database
services.persistence: indexed vectors and metadata on durable disk

services.access: private internal network with optional reverse-proxy exposure
services.name: RAG API
services.persistence: stateless service using the other layers

workflow_steps: run reusable local procedures through Skills
retrieve, rerank, generate, and cite through the RAG API
discover, parse, chunk, embed, index, and verify source documents
